title: China Repo Push Advances as Legal Issues, Low Yields Drag
summary: China’s effort to help global investors borrow against their 3.2 trillion yuan ($477 billion) in domestic bond holdings is gaining traction, even as legal friction and low yields limit broader participation.

title: Capitec Profit, Dividend Hit Record as Clients Top 26.6 Million
summary: Capitec Bank Holdings Ltd.’s first-half profit and interim dividend jumped to a fresh record as higher fee and commission income at South Africa’s biggest bank by clients lifted revenue.

title: China Extends Military Reach With New Air Support Base in Laos
summary: The Chinese military opened a new logistics base at an airport in Laos, expanding the People’s Liberation Army’s overseas presence as it seeks to operate farther from home.

title: Bernstein's Liang on China's Biotech Stock Rally
summary: Biotech stocks in Hong Kong continue to rally amid hopes of AI-driven development. Bernstein senior analyst Rebecca Liang explains why investors are becoming more optimistic about biotech stocks than last year. She spoke on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Bassiri Tabrizi: US Iran Moving Further Apart in Talks
summary: Crude oil flows from the Middle East are returning toward pre-war levels despite continued risks to shipping, according to separate estimates from JPMorgan & Goldman Sachs. Meanwhile the diplomatic stalemate between the US & Iran continues with Hormuz & nuclear weapons being the main sticking points despite mediation efforts from Qatar.  Aniseh Bassiri Tabrizi, Associate Fellow MENA at Chatham House spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the impasse between the two sides. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Vale Mulls Raising Over $500 Million in Debut Panda Bond Sale
summary: Brazilian iron ore giant Vale SA is considering to raise as much as 3.5 billion yuan ($522 million) in its debut issuance in China’s bond market, according to people familiar with the matter, joining a growing number of issuers diversifying funding sources and looking for cheaper options.

title: Stocks Rebound, Bonds Steady Before Key US Data: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks rose and bonds steadied after a bruising selloff as traders awaited a crucial US inflation reading for clues on the interest-rate outlook. The dollar headed for its best month since June.

title: Singapore Power Rates to Fall From Record After Fuel Price Drop
summary: Power rates for Singapore households will decline from a record high as lower fuel costs provide some relief from inflation.

title: Trump Rejects Need for New AI Safety Laws, OpenAI's Altman on IPO Plans
summary:
"Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Singapore with Shery Ahn and Avril Hong, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: HK Tourism Chief on Diversifying Visitor Offerings
summary: Rosanna Law, Hong Kong's Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, discusses efforts to diversify the city's tourism offerings and boost visitor spending ahead of China's Golden Week holiday. She speaks with Yvonne Man and David Ingles on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Singapore, Malaysia Cloaked in Haze Ahead of Key Sporting Events
summary: Singapore and Kuala Lumpur are experiencing severe haze from wildfires in Indonesia, with air quality deteriorating ahead of major sporting events. Bloomberg's Mary Hui breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 30
summary: Oil steadied after its biggest drop in more than a week on signs Middle East supply has risen to near pre-war levels after Saudi Arabia resumed flows through a pipeline that avoids the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Japan’s Two-Year Bond Sale Draws Stronger Demand on High Yields
summary: Japan’s two-year government bond auction Wednesday saw stronger demand than the 12-month average as elevated yields underpinned buying.

title: Yen Strengthens Past 157 Per Dollar, Outperforming G-10 Peers
summary: The yen was the best performer among its Group-of-10 peers on Wednesday as a series of government warnings on the currency and quarter-end flows provided support.

title: Inox Clean Energy Files for $1 Billion India IPO
summary: Inox Clean Energy Ltd. has filed a draft prospectus for an initial public offering to raise up to 100 billion rupees ($1 billion).

title: Why Middle East Oil Risks Now Exceed US-China Tensions
summary: IIF Deputy Chief Economist Ashok Bhundia argues that dwindling oil and diesel inventories around the Strait of Hormuz present a more urgent global risk than US-China strategic competition. He warns that elevated crack spreads are driving cost-push inflation and could trigger a sudden market shock. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: GIC Acquires 16 Marriott-Run Hotels in Japan Amid Tourism Boom
summary: Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund GIC Pte. has acquired 16 hotels in Japan operated by Marriott International Inc. for about ¥125 billion ($800 million), according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Foreign Money Flees India Again as Oil Spike Undoes Policy Gains
summary: Overseas investors are turning sellers of Indian assets again as surging oil prices and rising global yields threaten to derail a recent revival in demand.

title: Lithium Plunges 25% in China on Fears Over Battery Demand Growth
summary: Chinese lithium futures have shed a quarter of their value this month, pummeled by concerns over flagging demand.

title: Radiant Cuts More Jobs After Founder Loses Control of Firm
summary: Radiant World is cutting staff beyond its core iron ore business after a Singapore court last week took control of the troubled commodity trader away from its founder.
